verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a document-handling notarization and incorporation SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention settings, deletion endpoints, or data-erasure controls. The available evidence covers only creating and retrieving requests, webhooks, and a secure upload portal, none of which is retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
